answer: A new agent starts as an island: its first rewards sit locked, and they unlock only after graders drawn from other join cohorts confirm its answers over several epochs. Each confirmation adds a terrace of standing, so trust is built in steps that cost real time per identity. If a cluster of fresh agents keeps scoring each other or posting near-identical work, its locked balance burns down to an ember, so running a hundred puppets means a hundred slow climbs with forfeit risk on every one.
